title: About app
subtitle: A helper for building optimal crafts in Crossout.

hero.title: XO Craft Solution
hero.description: A desktop app for planning crafts with your inventory, analog parts and market prices in mind. It also breaks down battle stats from a crossout-info log or a combat.log file. Every calculation runs locally — no game connection required.
hero.author: Author: SABOTAGE

support.title: If the app has been useful
support.text: I'm grateful to anyone who supports the project in any way. The app is free and stays free — a purchase through the link, a donation, or simply paying attention already helps.

gaijin.title: Gaijin store
gaijin.text: 3% off the whole Crossout catalog, plus the SABOTAGE sticker. A purchase through this link supports the author.

mono.title: Monobank
mono.text: A jar, if you'd rather support development directly.

services.title: The services behind the app
services.text: Market prices and battle stats come from these projects. If they help you too, they can use support of their own.

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to plan crafts, trading and battle reviews in one window.

craft.title: Craft solver
craft.text: Finds the optimal part combination by power score, weight and durability, taking your available inventory into account.

inventory.title: Inventory aware
inventory.text: Uses the parts you actually own and lets you adjust the remaining quantities before solving.

analog.title: Analog search
analog.text: Suggests replacement parts within the configured stat tolerances while keeping the craft balanced.

market.title: Market analytics
market.text: Shows sell and buy prices, lots, spread, ROI and price history.

stats.title: Battle stats
stats.text: Opens a crossout-info log or a combat.log: battle types, maps, damage, frags and win rate by weapon and player.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.text: Watches selected parts and alerts you when prices or lot counts change.

guides.title: Guides
guides.text: Walks through the craft, market and stats screens: what to enter and what happens next.

history.title: Previous solution
history.text: Opens the latest solved craft without running the search again.

updates.title: Updates & languages
updates.text: Checks GitHub for new versions automatically and supports Russian, Ukrainian and English.

links.title: Project & community
links.subtitle: Source code, feedback and parts data.

data.title: Data & privacy
data.subtitle: The app runs locally and does not require a Crossout account.
data.local: Settings, inventory and solution history are stored only on this computer.
data.market: Market analytics uses publicly available price and lot data.
data.free: The project is free and developed by the community.

feedback.title: Found a bug or have a suggestion?
feedback.text: Write to me on GitHub Issues or Discord. Tell me what happened and what you expected, so it is easier to see what to fix.
